parseado.cita: Then ask the following question: 'In the light of how events unfolded and were perceived by those involved in real time, is it likely that this new individual would have behaved any differently?' ... A useful addition to the substitution test is to ask of the individual's peers
parseado.razon: El libro formula la misma pregunta de sustitución y la dirige expresamente a los pares o a un 'jury' de pares, que es a quienes apunta el nodo. El orden tras descartar abuso de sustancias e incumplimiento deliberado (L5057) es una sugerencia ('seems appropriate'). Formular la pregunta no lleva a hacer nada que el libro desaconseje.
